d:
This is not a beginner flow and it is not designed to keep you comfortable. It challenges your balance, coordination, core strength, mobility, and awareness through continuous full body movement that demands focus from start to finish.
You’ll move through twisting transitions, side planks, deep hip work, rotational strength, and dynamic balance patterns that leave you feeling powerful, clear, and deeply connected to your body. Practice becomes different when you stop trying to escape discomfort and start learning from it.
